2. DATABASE PIK-R KECAMATAN
- A clean, structured data table tracking active PIK-R groups across the 11 sub-districts (Kecamatan) of Kota Depok (Beji, Bojongsari, Cilodong, Cimanggis, Cinere, Cipayung, Limo, Pancoran Mas, Sawangan, Sukmajaya, Tapos).

  1. Ketua Umum, 2. Wakil Ketua, 3. Sekretaris 1, 4. Sekretaris 2, 5. Bendahara 1, 6. Bendahara 2, 7. Kabid Internal, 8. Kabid Eksternal, 9. Kabid Branding, 10. Duta GenRe Depok.
- Each position contains a sharp toggle button ("Hadir" / "Berhalangan") that acts as a digital disposition stamp, complete with a live counter: "Total Delegasi Hadir: X Orang".

4. AUTOMATED TOR & LPJ GENERATOR
- A clean multi-step Wizard Form layout on the left side of the screen.
- Step 1: Latar Belakang & Rumusan Masalah. Step 2: Tujuan & Target Anggota. Step 3: Waktu, Tempat & Pemateri. Step 4: Susunan Rundown Detail.
- Right-side Split Screen: A real-time live-preview layout formatting the inputted text into an official GenRe document look.
- Includes a prominent, crisp "Export to PDF" button that unlocks once all steps are completed.

5. PERSURATAN DIGITAL & SECRETARY APPROVAL

6. SMART KEUANGAN RAB (BENDAHARA HUB)

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT:
Provide the complete, fully functional React component code in a single file block. Use standard React Hooks (useState, useEffect) to manage the global routing navigation, data-adding logs, automated mock values, toggle states, and workflow logic seamlessly. Ensure all interactive components react immediately to user clicks and inputs.

  const [tab, setTab] = useState('ledger');

  const mockOCR = [
    { nominal:280000, tanggal:'2026-06-13', kategori:'Konsumsi', deskripsi:'Konsumsi Rapat Internal BPH - Nasi Box 14 porsi' },
    { nominal:75000, tanggal:'2026-06-13', kategori:'ATK', deskripsi:'Print & Fotokopi Dokumen Administrasi' },
    { nominal:450000, tanggal:'2026-06-12', kategori:'Transport', deskripsi:'Uang Transport Perwakilan ke BKKBN Pusat' },
    { nominal:1200000, tanggal:'2026-06-10', kategori:'Lainnya', deskripsi:'Sewa Tempat Pelatihan Kader PIK-R' },
  ];

  const income = transactions.filter(t=>t.type==='income').reduce((s,t)=>s+t.nominal,0);
  const expense = Math.abs(transactions.filter(t=>t.type==='expense').reduce((s,t)=>s+t.nominal,0));
  const balance = income - expense;

  const simulateOCR = (fname) => {
    setOcrLoading(true); setExtracted(null);
    const mock = mockOCR[Math.floor(Math.random()*mockOCR.length)];
    setTimeout(()=>{
      setOcrLoading(false);
      setExtracted(mock);
      setForm({nominal:String(mock.nominal),tanggal:mock.tanggal,kategori:mock.kategori,deskripsi:mock.deskripsi,type:'expense'});
      notify(`AI mengekstrak struk "${fname}" — data siap disimpan`,'success');
    }, 1800);
  };

  const onDrop = (e) => { e.preventDefault();setDragover(false);const f=e.dataTransfer.files[0];if(f)simulateOCR(f.name); };
  const onFileChange = (e) => { const f=e.target.files[0];if(f)simulateOCR(f.name); };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if(!form.nominal||!form.tanggal||!form.deskripsi) { notify('Lengkapi data transaksi','error'); return; }

    const newTx = {
      id: Date.now(), date: form.tanggal,
      desc: form.deskripsi, kategori: form.kategori,
      nominal: form.type==='income'?n:-n, type: form.type
    };
    setTransactions(t=>[...t,newTx]);
    setForm({nominal:'',tanggal:'',kategori:'',deskripsi:'',type:'expense'});
    setExtracted(null);
    notify('Transaksi berhasil disimpan ke buku besar','success');
  };

      </div>

      <div className="fin-summary" style={{marginBottom:'18px'}}>
        <div className="fin-summary-grid">
          <div className="fin-metric">
            <div className="fin-metric-label">Total Pemasukan</div>
            <div className="fin-metric-value income">{formatRupiah(income)}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:'10px',color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)',marginTop:'4px'}}>{transactions.filter(t=>t.type==='income').length} transaksi masuk</div>
          </div>
          <div className="fin-divider"></div>
          <div className="fin-metric">
            <div className="fin-metric-label">Total Pengeluaran</div>
            <div className="fin-metric-value expense">- {formatRupiah(expense)}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:'10px',color:'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)',marginTop:'4px'}}>{transactions.filter(t=>t.type==='expense').length} transaksi keluar</div>
          </div>
          <div className="fin-divider"></div>
          <div className="fin-metric">
            <div className="fin-metric-label">Sisa Saldo</div>
            <div className="fin-metric-value balance">{formatRupiah(balance)}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:'10px',color:balance>=0?'#6ee7b7':'#fca5a5',marginTop:'4px'}}>{balance>=0?'↑ Saldo Aman':'⚠ Saldo Minus'}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{display:'grid',gridTemplateColumns:'360px 1fr',gap:'16px'}}>
        {/* Upload & Form */}
        <div>
          <div className="card" style={{marginBottom:'12px'}}>
            <div className="card-header"><div className="card-title">🧾 Upload Struk / Invoice</div></div>
            <div className="card-body" style={{padding:'14px'}}>
              <div
                className={`dropzone${dragover?' dragover':''}`}
                style={{padding:'20px'}}
                onClick={()=>!ocrLoading&&fileRef.current.click()}
                onDrop={onDrop}
                onDragOver={e=>{e.preventDefault();setDragover(true);}}
                onDragLeave={()=>setDragover(false)}
              >
                <input ref={fileRef} type="file" style={{display:'none'}} accept=".jpg,.jpeg,.png,.pdf" onChange={onFileChange} />
                {ocrLoading ? (
                  <div>
                    <div className="dropzone-icon pulse">🤖</div>
                    <div className="dropzone-text" style={{color:'var(--accent-blue)'}}>AI Membaca Struk...</div>
                    <div style={{marginTop:'10px',height:'4px',background:'var(--border)',borderRadius:'2px',overflow:'hidden'}}>
                      <div className="pulse" style={{height:'100%',background:'var(--accent-blue)',width:'60%'}}></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div>
                    <div className="dropzone-icon">🧾</div>
                    <div className="dropzone-text">Upload Struk / Invoice</div>
                    <div className="dropzone-sub">JPG, PNG, PDF — OCR otomatis</div>

            </div>
          </div>

              {extracted && (

                  <div className="receipt-extracted-label">✓ Data dari OCR Struk</div>

              <div className="form-group">

                <input className="form-control" value={form.nominal} onChange={e=>setForm(f=>({...f,nominal:e.target.value}))} placeholder="contoh: 350000" style={{fontFamily:'monospace'}} />
                {form.nominal && <div className="helper-text">{formatRupiah(parseInt(form.nominal.replace(/\D/g,''))||0)}</div>}
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Tanggal Transaksi *</label>

              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Kategori</label>
                <select className="form-control" value={form.kategori} onChange={e=>setForm(f=>({...f,kategori:e.target.value}))}>

              <div className="form-group">

              </div>
              <button className="btn btn-primary w-full" onClick={handleSave} id="btn-simpan-transaksi">💾 Simpan ke Buku Besar</button>

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Ledger */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="card-header">
            <div className="card-title">📒 Buku Besar Keuangan</div>
            <div style={{display:'flex',alignItems:'center',gap:'8px'}}>
              <span className="badge badge-gray">{transactions.length} Transaksi</span>

                  let running = 0;
